{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Confirm 'loyal' is valid (already confirmed)
assert 'loyal' in sales['customer_segment'].unique(), "'loyal' not found in customer_segment"

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales[
    (sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (sales['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Check if any QA orders remain (should be 0)
qa_check = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue'] == '999999.99']
assert len(qa_check) == 0, f"QA orders found in loyal_completed: {len(qa_check)}"

# Check if any refunded orders remain
refunded_check = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['status'] == 'refunded']
assert len(refunded_check) == 0, f"Refunded orders found in loyal_completed: {len(refunded_check)}"

# Convert revenue from string to float
# Remove commas and cast to float
loyal_completed['revenue_numeric'] = (
    loyal_completed['revenue']
    .str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
    .astype(float)
)

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_numeric'].mean()

# Output result
print(f"Number of loyal completed orders: {len(loyal_completed)}")
print(f"Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}")"}
